tast: Improve SSH's API to push files. SSH.PutTreeRename used to take the base directory in the local and remote host and files were specified in paths relative to the base directory. Assumption here was that we usually want to push files under a base directory, but it is not true today especially when a test bundle binary and local_test_runner are pushed at once. This CL changes the method to take just one map whose key is an absolute/relative path to a local file and value is an absolute path to a remote file. Since we no longer have concept of the base directory, the method is renamed from PutTreeRename to PutFiles. CRAS: bt_device - Better handle BT audio profile drop This change fixes two things: (1) If BT headset connected, but not able to connect HFP/HSP until timeout, it shall eventually disconnect. (2) If BT headset connected and in use, then A2DP disconnects for some reason, the headset shall disconnect instead of fallback to use HFP/HSP. This change adds cras_bt_device_notify_profile_dropped() as a more generic function to handle unexpected profile drop, by scheduling a full suspend of BT device. We used to rely on the event when HFP AG is dropped and destroyed to send disconnect message to bluetoothd, to make sure the device state changed back to 'disconnected'. However this logic had a bug that if a headset never established an HFP AG, it could miss the disconnect message and leaving BT UI showing the headset still connected. BUG=chromium:755242, b:133790771 TEST=Use unittest to verify. What this change fixes is just difficult to reproduce. autotest: cellular: Remove routing assumptions that break enviroment setup The cellular environment setup for both regular modems and pseudomodem had a few assumptions about the system's routing setup that per-device routing has broken. This change updates the code involving these assumptions so that they comply with the actual routing setup. A more permanent solution that would make it easier to make large changes to the routing setup in the future would be to have a central routing implementation that all other code uses for routing changes (think client/cros/routing.py, but more flexible and containing all the functionality needed within autotest). BUG=chromium:978245, chromium:941597 TEST=`test_that $DUT cellular_Smoke.pseudomodem && test_that $DUT cellular_ConnectFailure.pseudomodem && test_that $DUT autoupdate_Cellular.delta && test_that $DUT cellular_DisableWhileConnecting.fibocom-l850gl` is now passing (it still sometimes flakes, but it can now actually pass as well). CHROMIUM: bluetooth: Enable filter duplicates field for passive scan This sets the filter duplicates field in LE Set Scan Enabled command to enabled for passive scanning. By enabling the field, the advertisement reports from the same address would be sent to the host once per passive scan cycle. However, since the buffer to keep the seen address is limited (e.g. the size of buffer is 50 for Intel controllers), the host will still be interrupted by any advertisement report with new addresses beyond the size of the buffer. (2) Start btmon and confirm the mouse is connected by moving the mouse and observe ATT data in btmon. (3) Turn off the mouse and wait for 30 seconds. btmon prints HCI traffic of passive scanning. And the filtering duplicates was applied to at least 50 addresses in Bluetooth-noisy environment. hci: Choose legacy advertising over extended advertising commands. Bluetooth 5.0 (Vol 2, Part E, section 3.1.1) disallows mixing of legacy and extended advertising commands. However, there is no command to explicitly choose which mode (legacy or extended) the host wants to use, but rather the first advertising command will determine whether legacy or extended advertising commands will be allowed for the rest of the controller's lifetime (until Reset). So we call an arbitrary read-only legacy advertising command very early to tell the controller that we want to use the legacy advertising commands instead of extended advertising commands. Without specifying legacy vs extended commands very early, we might hit an unexpected Command Disallowed later on. For example, LE Set Scan Parameters hits Command Disallowed error on Thunder Peak. BUG=chromium:982443 TEST=Manual scanning test on atlas (Thunder Peak).
